purpose: Use H/Ru(0001) as a deliberately difficult limit test in which the workflow must identify when a classical harmonic surface-diffusion treatment is insufficient and must refuse a full rate claim unless nuclear quantum effects are explicitly resolved.

published_outcomes_already_known: quantum effects are experimentally evident at temperatures up to roughly 200 K
a low-temperature tunneling-dominated plateau is reported
published ab initio PIMD/QTST reproduces higher-temperature behavior more successfully than the low-temperature tunneling rate
published static calculations report fcc/hcp/bridge energetics
exposure_and_quarantine.forbidden_uses: These exposed kinetic, barrier, site-energy and rate values may not choose the new XC functional, pseudopotentials, cutoffs, k-mesh, slab size, bead count, path, free-energy windows, friction model, or acceptance threshold.
exposure_and_quarantine.allowed_use: The published experimental temperature interval may define the external comparison state points because those are measurement conditions rather than fit targets.

external_primary_source.citation: McIntosh et al., Quantum Effects in the Diffusion of Hydrogen on Ru(0001), J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 4, 1565-1569 (2013)
external_primary_source.role: held-out experimental and published-theory comparator after the new protocol is frozen

electronic_structure_method_selection.selection_principle: Choose the lowest-cost method that passes non-kinetic structural, vibrational, pseudopotential-provenance and numerical-convergence gates. Kinetic agreement is forbidden as a selector.
minimum_non_kinetic_gates: Ru bulk lattice and numerical convergence
H adsorption-site screen including fcc, hcp, bridge and top without assuming the published minimum
local H vibrational-mode stability for the numerically selected adsorption minimum

classical_reaction_path_tier.purpose: Establish the classical Born-Oppenheimer PES, minima, MEP, saddle and harmonic baseline independently of quantum-rate agreement.
minimum_path_requirements: construct the lowest-energy adjacent-site path from the numerical minima rather than imposing fcc-to-hcp if the calculation disagrees
verified saddle with one unstable mode aligned with the computed path
retain classical harmonic TST as the conventional baseline even if it later fails
classical_reaction_path_tier.classical_rate_claim_scope: BASELINE_ONLY over the measured temperature interval unless an independently justified high-temperature classical regime is demonstrated prospectively

nuclear_quantum_tier.reason: The selected contrast system has published experimental evidence of nuclear quantum effects within the external comparison interval; a static classical barrier plus harmonic prefactor is therefore knowingly incomplete as a full rate model.

primary_open_implementation_route.electronic_force_client: Quantum ESPRESSO PWscf through its documented i-PI socket interface
technical_basis: Quantum ESPRESSO documents pw.x --ipi with calculation='scf' for force-client operation
i-PI documents Quantum ESPRESSO as an out-of-box client and supports PIMD
primary_open_implementation_route.method_role: constrained-centroid PIMD free-energy calculation followed by a prospectively defined QTST rate expression

ring_polymer_beads.exposure_note: The published H/Ru study used 16 beads and tested 32/64. Those values are known and therefore are not treated as blind evidence.
ring_polymer_beads.selection_rule: At each registered temperature, choose the smallest P for which the computed free-energy barrier changes by <= 0.005 eV on doubling P. If 32->64 fails, return QUANTUM_BEAD_CONVERGENCE_HOLD rather than extrapolating or relaxing the threshold.

nuclear_quantum_tier.reaction_coordinate_rule: The constrained-centroid coordinate must be defined from the newly computed adjacent-site MEP. Published fcc-hcp labels may describe the comparator but cannot override a different newly computed minimum/path.
nuclear_quantum_tier.centroid_coordinate_limitation: If the centroid coordinate becomes demonstrably non-representative in a strongly asymmetric deep-tunneling regime, return QUANTUM_REACTION_COORDINATE_HOLD. Do not switch to another quantum rate theory after inspecting experimental rate agreement without a separately frozen amendment.
nuclear_quantum_tier.instanton_note: i-PI includes ring-polymer instanton functionality, but its own documentation cautions that the implementation is not applicable to condensed phases. It is therefore not an automatic rescue method for H/Ru(0001).

required_later: identify an independently sourced projected friction/damping quantity for the same H diffusion coordinate and state point
separate measured dephasing from population relaxation and model-fitted friction
demonstrate condition compatibility with the barrier/free-energy calculation

compute_environment_gate.reason: PIMD requires multiple force-evaluation replicas. The current standard GitHub-hosted environment has already been shown insufficient for a single 177-atom Na/Cu adsorption calculation and cannot be presumed suitable for multi-replica ab initio H/Ru PIMD.
compute_environment_gate.acceptable_route: qualify a larger/self-hosted/HPC environment first and record memory/runtime scaling with a non-admissible pilot before production PIMD
